overview.summary: Experience the vibrant cultural pulse of Chennai on a solo weekend getaway. Discover ancient Dravidian temples, colonial history, coastal beach walks, and authentic South Indian culinary delights.
overview.best_time_note: Late September offers pleasant morning coastal breezes and manageable humidity levels before the northeast monsoon peaks.

weather.conditions: Warm, humid with sunny intervals and coastal breezes

options.details: Direct flights from Mumbai (BOM) to Chennai (MAA) on IndiGo or Air India
pros: Maximizes sightseeing time for a 3-day trip

options.details: Superfast Express trains like Chennai Mail or Express from LTT/CSMT to MAS
cons: Takes almost a full day each way, reducing trip duration

transport.recommendation_reason: With only 3 days for a weekend trip, flying saves over 40 hours of transit time while keeping total costs well within your INR 20,000 budget.
transport.local_transport: Chennai Metro, Namma Yatri / Uber auto-rickshaws, and ride-hailing cabs

stay.area_recommendation: Mylapore or Nungambakkam for excellent connectivity, proximity to heritage sites, and safety for solo travelers.

options.name: Zostel Chennai
options.why_good: Social vibe, clean dorms and private rooms, great location for solo travellers.

options.name: The Residency Chennai
options.area: G N Chetty Road, T. Nagar
options.why_good: Central location, comfortable rooms, superb South Indian breakfast spread.

morning.activity: Catch morning flight from Mumbai to Chennai
morning.tip: Opt for an early flight around 06:00 AM to arrive in Chennai by 08:00 AM.

morning.activity: Take Chennai Metro or prepaid auto to accommodation, check-in and refresh
morning.tip: Store bags at reception if early check-in is not yet available.

afternoon.activity: Visit the 7th-century Kapaleeshwarar Temple and explore surrounding bazaar lanes
afternoon.tip: Dress conservatively with covered shoulders and knees. Remove footwear outside.

afternoon.activity: Traditional South Indian Thali lunch at Rayar's Mess or Jannal Kadai
afternoon.tip: Try authentic filter coffee after lunch.

evening.activity: Sunset stroll along Marina Beach, world's second-longest natural urban beach
evening.tip: Try hot chilly bajjis and beach sundal from regulated food stalls.

meals.breakfast: South Indian Tiffin at Murugan Idli Shop
meals.lunch: Full Banana Leaf Meal at Rayar's Mess
meals.dinner: Ghee Roast Dosa at Ratna Cafe, Triplicane

morning.activity: Visit Fort St. George Museum (birthplace of modern Chennai) and St. Mary's Church
morning.tip: Carry a valid government photo ID for security entry.

morning.activity: Visit Government Museum, Egmore to admire Bronze Gallery sculptures
morning.tip: The Bronze Gallery is a must-see for Chola art lovers.

afternoon.activity: Lunch and stroll around historical San Thome Cathedral Basilica
afternoon.tip: Visit the underground tomb chapel beneath the basilica.

evening.activity: Relax at Besant Nagar (Elliot's) Beach and explore trendy beachside cafes
evening.tip: Bessie Beach is cleaner and quieter than Marina, perfect for solo travelers.

meals.breakfast: Podi Idli & Vadai at Triplicane local mess
meals.dinner: Dinner at Mash Resto Cafe or Murugan Idli Shop near Besant Nagar

morning.activity: Morning walk under Banyan trees at Theosophical Society gardens
morning.tip: Check morning opening hours; morning access is usually 08:30 to 10:00 AM.

morning.activity: Souvenir shopping for Kanchipuram silks or handicrafts in Pondy Bazaar
morning.tip: Use Metro from AG-DMS for easy transit avoiding road traffic.

afternoon.tip: Try spicy Chettinad chicken or mushroom curry with parotta.

evening.activity: Head to Chennai Airport for evening return flight to Mumbai
evening.tip: Take the Direct Metro line from T. Nagar/Teynampet straight into the airport terminal.

meals.breakfast: Pongal and Filter Coffee at Saravana Bhavan

places_to_visit.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
places_to_visit.why_visit: Stunning 7th-century Dravidian gopuram architectural marvel dedicated to Lord Shiva.

places_to_visit.name: Marina Beach
places_to_visit.why_visit: Iconic stretch offering local food stalls, lighthouse views, and sea breeze.

places_to_visit.name: Government Museum, Egmore
places_to_visit.why_visit: Houses world-renowned Chola bronze sculptures and ancient archaeological artifacts.

places_to_visit.name: San Thome Cathedral Basilica
places_to_visit.why_visit: Neo-Gothic church built over the tomb of Saint Thomas, one of Jesus Christ's apostles.

places_to_visit.name: Elliot's Beach (Besant Nagar)
places_to_visit.why_visit: Clean, relaxed beach atmospheric spot surrounded by vibrant cafes.

food_to_try.where: Mylapore Filter Coffee or Rayar's Mess
Murugan Idli Shop or Saravana Bhavan

packing_list: Breathable cotton clothes suitable for humid weather
Comfortable slip-on footwear (easy for temple visits)
Sunscreen, sunglasses, and a compact umbrella
Modest attire covering shoulders and knees for temple entry
Reusable water bottle and small daypack
safety_and_tips: Use auto-rickshaw hailing apps like Namma Yatri or Uber Auto to get transparent upfront fares.
Chennai Metro connects the airport directly to central hubs like Egmore and Central, avoiding road traffic.
Keep cash handy for small mess joints and beach vendor stalls.
Respect temple dress codes and remove shoes before entering sacred premises.
